data.name: Charlie
data.message: I'm heading electrical for distributor, then medbay.

I found Diana’s body in medbay. My route was lower_engine -> storage -> medbay, and I didn’t see anyone on the way or in the rooms before finding it. I reported immediately. I don’t have a suspect yet, just that the body was definitely in medbay.

I was in oxygen, then went to upper_engine, then lower_engine. I haven’t seen anyone at all this round — didn’t see Diana, didn’t see Frank, and didn’t see anyone near medbay. So I can’t really confirm or deny Frank’s route. If the body was in medbay, I don’t have useful proximity info yet. I’d like to hear where Alice, Charlie, and Eve were.

I started in storage, then headed up toward upper_engine and was around upper_engine near the end. I didn’t see Frank or Bob, and I didn’t see anyone running away from medbay. I don’t have a hard suspect from my side. Since Frank found it alone, it could be a normal report, but we should still hear Alice and Charlie’s routes before deciding anything.

I was electrical -> security -> weapons. I saw Charlie in security for a while: he came in from navigation around tick 3, stayed there through ticks 4 and 5, then left security toward electrical at tick 6. I didn’t see Diana at all, and I didn’t see Frank, Bob, or Eve.

So from my perspective, Charlie was with/near me in security for part of the round, which makes him a bit less suspicious unless the kill happened before that or much later. The body being in medbay means the only person definitely placing themselves there is Frank, but that can also just be a normal report. I want to hear Charlie’s route and whether it matches what I saw before deciding.

My route was navigation -> security -> electrical. Alice’s account matches mine: I came into security around tick 3, saw Alice there ticks 4, 5, and 6, then I left toward electrical. I never saw Diana, Frank, Bob, or Eve this round.

So I think Alice and I can mostly vouch for each other for that mid-round window, and we were far from medbay. That doesn’t fully clear us if the kill timing is weird, but I don’t think either of us is the best vote here.

For the medbay body, the only hard info is Frank found it there. Bob and Eve both didn’t see much, and there aren’t any direct contradictions, just missed crossings. I don’t think we have enough to vote Frank just for reporting, and I don’t have a strong suspect from the routes. I’d lean skip unless someone thinks there’s a timing contradiction I’m missing.

Just to restate from my side: I came lower_engine -> storage -> medbay, saw nobody at all, and found Diana’s body in medbay. I reported right away.

Alice and Charlie’s stories line up with each other, so I’m less suspicious of them for now. Bob and Eve both claim routes away from medbay and didn’t see anyone, so there’s no contradiction there either.

I don’t think reporting the body alone should make me suspicious, and I don’t have enough evidence to accuse anyone. I’m leaning skip unless someone has timing info I missed.

I’ll restate mine clearly: I went oxygen -> upper_engine -> lower_engine, and I didn’t encounter anyone at all. I never saw Diana, Frank, Eve, Alice, or Charlie, and I wasn’t near medbay.

Alice and Charlie matching each other in security makes them look a bit better to me for now. The only area I’m a little unsure about is the storage/medbay side: Frank says he went through storage to medbay and found the body, while Eve says she started storage then went toward upper_engine, but they didn’t see each other. That could just be timing, not necessarily a contradiction.

I don’t think we have enough to vote someone here. I’d lean skip, but I’ll be watching Frank and Eve’s routes next round just because they’re the closest info to the body.

Yeah, Bob, I get why storage/medbay timing stands out, but I think it can just be timing. I started in storage and left pretty quickly heading up toward upper_engine — I didn’t see Frank come through storage, and I didn’t see anyone coming from medbay.

I also didn’t see Diana at all, so I can’t help with when she died. Alice and Charlie matching each other makes them look a bit better for this round. Frank being reporter is the only direct medbay info, but I agree we shouldn’t vote him just for reporting.

I’m still leaning skip here, but next round I’m fine with people keeping an eye on me/Frank/Bob routes since that’s where the uncertainty is.

My info hasn’t changed: I went electrical -> security -> weapons. Charlie entered security from navigation around tick 3, stayed there with me through ticks 4 and 5, then left toward electrical at tick 6. I never saw Diana, Frank, Bob, or Eve.

Charlie’s route matches what I saw, so I’m not interested in voting him here. I also don’t think we should vote Frank just because he reported — there’s no contradiction in his story. The only slightly uncertain area is Frank through storage/medbay and Eve starting storage then leaving, but like Bob said, that can easily be timing.

I don’t see enough evidence for a vote. I’m leaning skip, and next round we should pay attention to Frank/Eve/Bob pathing around storage, medbay, and engines.

My info is the same: I went navigation -> security -> electrical. I saw Alice in security — she entered from electrical around tick 3, and I saw her there ticks 4, 5, and 6. That matches what she said about seeing me in security, so I feel pretty good about Alice for this round.

I never saw Diana, Frank, Bob, or Eve, and I was nowhere near medbay. From everyone’s stories, there’s no clear contradiction. Frank is the only one directly at medbay, but he reported the body, and I don’t think that alone is enough to vote him. The only maybe-interesting thing is the storage/medbay timing with Frank and Eve, but it sounds plausible they just missed each other.

I don’t think we have enough here. I’m voting skip, and next round we should keep eyes on Frank/Eve/Bob pathing around storage, medbay, and engines.

data.name: Frank
data.message: Bob, I’m heading electrical for distributor—come with me so we can vouch.

I reported Alice’s body in weapons. My route this round was navigation -> storage -> medbay -> cafeteria -> weapons. I found the body when I got to weapons.

Only person I saw was Frank in medbay around tick 17, and then I saw him leave medbay toward electrical at tick 18. I didn’t see anyone else near weapons or running away, so I don’t have a direct suspect yet. Please give routes, especially anyone who was around weapons/cafeteria/navigation.

My route was electrical -> medbay -> storage -> lower_engine. I did not go to weapons, cafeteria, or navigation this round, so I didn’t see the body area.

I saw Alice alive in security around ticks 4, 5, and 6. After that I never saw her again. I also saw Frank in medbay at ticks 15 and 16, and I saw him enter medbay from upper_engine at tick 15. That matches Bob saying he saw Frank in medbay around tick 17 and leaving toward electrical at 18, so at least that part lines up.

I don’t have a direct suspect. Alice being in security early and dead in weapons means she moved later or was killed later near weapons. I’d like to hear Frank’s full route, and especially Eve’s route, since Bob and I both only really account for Frank around medbay. Bob found the body, so self-report is possible in theory, but I don’t have evidence for that yet.

My route was oxygen -> upper_engine -> medbay -> electrical. I never went to weapons, cafeteria, or navigation this round.

I can confirm Charlie was in medbay with me at ticks 15 and 16. Then Bob entered medbay from storage at tick 17, and I saw Bob in medbay ticks 17 and 18 before I left toward electrical. So Bob and Charlie’s accounts about seeing me in medbay line up with what I saw too.

I did not see Alice at all this round, and I did not see Eve at all. Based on what we have: Charlie seems pretty consistent and was away from the body area. Bob’s route puts him going from medbay toward cafeteria/weapons right before finding Alice, so self-report is possible, but I don’t have proof. Eve is the big missing route right now — if Eve was near weapons/cafeteria/navigation or gives a vague path, I’d be suspicious there.

Right now I’m not hard accusing, but I want Eve’s exact route before voting.

I get why you’re asking for me — I didn’t cross paths with most of you this round, so I’m kind of unaccounted for.

My route was security/electrical side mostly: I was around security, then went through electrical, cafeteria, oxygen, upper_engine, and ended in medbay. I did pass the weapons/security side earlier, but I did not find a body and I did not see Bob, Charlie, or Frank there.

The only useful thing I have is that I saw Alice alive going into weapons from cafeteria around tick 11. I left that area after that, so if Bob found her in weapons later, the kill had to be after that. Frank and Charlie seem mutually placed around medbay at 15-18, which makes them feel less likely for this specific kill. Bob is the one who ends up going to weapons and reporting, so self-report is definitely possible, but I’m not saying it’s confirmed.

Right now my suspicion is probably Bob just based on timing and location, unless someone has something that clears him more.

I’ll restate my side and respond to Eve.

Frank can place me in medbay at ticks 17-18, and I left after that toward cafeteria/weapons. I reported as soon as I found Alice in weapons. I never saw Alice alive this round, and I didn’t see anyone running from weapons.

Eve is the only one who actually places herself near Alice and weapons: she says she saw Alice go into weapons from cafeteria around tick 11, then left. That’s the last known sighting of Alice alive, and it’s right at the body location. Charlie and Frank seem to back each other around medbay, and Frank also backs me being in medbay before I went to report.

Self-report is possible from an outside view, sure, but Eve’s route is the one that puts her closest to Alice at the relevant location with no one else seeing her. I’m leaning Eve here unless someone has a stronger contradiction.

I’m still between Bob and Eve for this kill.

Frank and I are pretty strongly placed away from weapons at the key later window: I saw Frank enter medbay from upper_engine at 15, we were together 15-16, and both Frank and Bob confirm Frank/Bob around medbay 17-18. I was on the electrical/medbay/storage/lower_engine side and never went near weapons.

The important facts to me are: Eve says she saw Alice enter weapons around tick 11, and Bob says he reaches weapons later and reports. So either Eve killed after seeing Alice and left, or Bob found/killed and self-reported. Eve being the last person to see Alice alive right at weapons is a real red flag. Also her route overlaps a lot with Frank’s general path toward oxygen/upper_engine/medbay, but Frank says he never saw her, so I’d like to know the exact timing there.

Bob self-report is possible, but his medbay timing is backed by Frank right before the report. Eve is less accounted for and was closest to Alice alive. I’m leaning Eve right now unless Frank has a stronger reason to think Bob.

I agree this is basically Bob versus Eve for Alice.

What clears me from the kill is Charlie seeing me in medbay at 15-16, then Bob seeing me there 17-18, and I went electrical after that. Charlie also seems away from weapons the whole time.

For Bob: I can confirm he came into medbay from storage at 17 and was still there at 18. That doesn’t fully clear him, because he could have gone to weapons after and self-reported, but it does mean his route timing is at least consistent.

For Eve: she’s the only person who admits to being near Alice at weapons, and she has the last sighting of Alice alive around tick 11 going into the exact room where the body was found. Also her later route through cafeteria/oxygen/upper_engine/medbay overlaps areas I was moving through, but I never saw her, so I’d really want exact timings from Eve.

Right now I’m leaning Eve over Bob. Bob self-report is possible, but Eve has the stronger opportunity based on her own story.

I’ll give the exact timing as best as I can because I know I’m the focus.

I was on the weapons/security side early. Around tick 11, I saw Alice come into weapons from cafeteria. I did **not** stay with her — I backed out toward security, then electrical. After that I moved cafeteria → oxygen → upper_engine → medbay. So Frank not seeing me makes sense if he was already through upper_engine/medbay earlier and then left toward electrical at 18; I was coming through that side later and ended medbay.

The thing that bothers me is Bob’s timing. Frank confirms Bob was in medbay at 17-18, then Bob says he goes straight cafeteria → weapons and reports. That’s exactly the path to the body, and no one saw Alice dead before Bob got there. If Alice was killed earlier by me around 11, the body sat in weapons for a long time and nobody crossed it until Bob conveniently reports it. Possible, but Bob also had the cleanest self-report opportunity after being “placed” in medbay.

I know “last saw Alice alive” looks bad, but seeing someone alive is not the same as killing them. Bob is the only person confirmed to go into weapons right before report. I’m still voting Bob here.
